Gradient and stripe fills

Source: R/fills.R
gradient_fill.Rd

Fills for [box_style()] and [bb_placeholder()].

Usage

gradient_fill(colors, stops = NULL, dir = "lr")

stripe_fill(colors = c("panel", "panel_alt"), angle = 45, width = 8/96)

Arguments

colors

Colours (theme names allowed). Two or more for gradients; exactly two for stripes.

stops

Optional gradient stops in `[0, 1]`.

dir

Gradient direction: `"lr"`, `"rl"`, `"tb"`, `"bt"`, `"tlbr"`, `"bltr"`, `"trbl"` or `"brtl"`.

angle

Stripe angle in degrees from horizontal (0 < angle < 180).

width

Stripe width (`grid::unit` or inches). Gaps have the same width.

Value

A `bb_fill` object.

Details

`gradient_fill()` uses grid's linear gradients (R >= 4.1 on a device that supports them, such as `cairo_pdf()`); elsewhere it falls back to the first colour.

`stripe_fill()` draws diagonal bands as clipped polygons, so it works on every device. The first colour is the ground, the second the stripes.

Examples

gradient_fill(c("#2f6cab", "#173052"))
#> $type
#> [1] "gradient"
#> 
#> $colors
#> [1] "#2f6cab" "#173052"
#> 
#> $stops
#> NULL
#> 
#> $dir
#> [1] "lr"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_fill"
stripe_fill(c("panel", "panel_alt"), angle = 45, width = unit(8, "pt"))
#> $type
#> [1] "stripes"
#> 
#> $colors
#> [1] "panel"     "panel_alt"
#> 
#> $angle
#> [1] 45
#> 
#> $width
#> [1] 0.110696
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_fill"
